name: Shahlon Silk Industries Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2008, Shahlon Silk Industries Ltd manufactures fabric on water jet looms, air jet looms & rapier looms[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
SSIL is a part of Shahlon Group. It is a fully integrated textile enterprise based in Surat  which deals as a yarn marketing agency, texturising, twisting, sizing, yarn dyeing, weaving, finish fabrics and industrial infrastructure. It manufactures texturised, twisted, synthetic, sized yarn and grey fabric and also trades in partially oriented and fully drawn yarn. It is also del credere agent for Reliance Industries Ltd
